newsitem.title: USA: Arkansas crop planting advances, corn completed.
newsitem.headline: Arkansas crop planting advances, corn completed.

text.p: The Arkansas corn crop was 100 percent planted and cotton was 98 percent planted during the week ended Sunday, according to the weekly Agricultural Statistics Service crop update.
Corn was rated five percent excellent, 49 good, 43 fair and three poor.
Soybeans were 44 percent planted and 22 emerged versus 40 and 27 a year ago, respectively, and the 31 and 18 averages. The crop was rated two percent excellent, 33 good, 62 fair and three poor.
Soft red winter wheat was 100 percent headed versus 100 a year ago and the 99 average. The crop was rated four percent excellent, 27 good, 47 fair, 20 poor and two very poor.
Rice was 96 percent planted and 77 emerged versus 94 and 81 a year ago, respectively, and the 90 and 78 averages. The crop was rated 11 percent excellent, 38 good, 38 fair, 11 poor and two very poor.
Soil moisture was rated three percent surplus, 45 adequate, 45 short and seven very short.
